rca_of_issue: Root cause: DateTimePickerModal was a React Native Modal nested inside the day Modal. On React Native Web, two overlapping Modals cause z-index/overlay conflicts making the second modal invisible or inaccessible. Fix: Replaced DateTimePickerModal with InlineTimePicker component (a plain View, not a Modal) that renders conditionally inside the sheet view using showPicker state flag. When showPicker=true, the InlineTimePicker replaces the AddSection view within the same sheet. No nested modals = no web overlay conflict.
